title: Public Trader Identity: Adverse Selection and Return Predictability
abstract: arXiv:2608.04373v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Informed traders are supposed to need anonymity: they profit by hiding among the uninformed. A decentralized exchange now publishes the counterparty. Every committed order, cancellation, rejection, and fill carries a persistent pseudonymous wallet address. We reconstruct the full-depth limit order book from a record of 17.1 billion messages and 14.3 million aggressive orders by 147,113 wallets, covering $84.3 billion in taker notional. We report three findings. First, informativeness is a persistent wallet attribute. Wallets ranked by the price movement following their aggressive orders retain that ordering across adjacent ten-day windows, with a rank correlation of 0.52. Second, the ranking predicts returns. translated_title: 公共交易者身份：逆向选择与收益可预测性
translated_abstract: 摘要：知情交易者通常被认为需要匿名性：他们通过隐藏在不知情者中获利。然而，一个去中心化交易所现在公开了交易对手方。每一笔已提交的订单、取消、拒绝和成交都带有持久的伪匿名钱包地址。我们根据147,113个钱包的171亿条消息和1430万笔激进订单重建了全深度限价订单簿，覆盖了843亿美元的吃单名义价值。我们报告了三个发现。第一，信息含量是一个持久的钱包属性。根据激进订单后的价格变动对钱包进行排名，该排名在相邻的十天窗口内保持不变，排名相关性为0.52。第二，该排名预测收益。将最高排名钱包的实时活动添加到标准匿名基准（包括价格、报价和订单流）中，将一秒收益的样本外R²提高到12.31%，增加了13.2%（t = 9.2），是基准的1.6倍。
tldr: 该论文发现去中心化交易所中交易者身份公开后，钱包的信息含量是持久的，且基于此排名能显著提高收益预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that in a decentralized exchange with public trader identities, wallet informativeness is persistent, and rankings based on it significantly enhance return predictability.
